searchText: Hey, just seeing this message 🙂 In theory one could snarkify the beacon chain (and indeed some teams like Grandine are trying to do that) but the beacon chain is not snark-friendly. I expect the beam chain to be ~100x more snark-friendly than the beacon chain, e.g. thanks to friendlier hashes.
